name: knight stones on a seven by four
description: A seven by four board whose middle file (d) is a wall that no stone stands on and no jump crosses, so the play is on two three by four fields. Every other square starts with a stone, the two players' alternating like the colours of a checkerboard. A move takes an enemy stone a knight's jump away, moving onto it; a stone never moves except to take, and the player who cannot move loses.
summary: Two three by four fields of stones.
A stone takes by a knight's jump.
The player who cannot move loses.
